profile.source: Hy4 admission profile (512 MiB compute base, 320 KiB/row, 256 MiB sparse, 256 MiB index)

formula: kv = x1.2(KV_BASE + kv_fixed_ladder + kv_per_ctx*ctx); compute = x1.2(COMPUTE_BASE + COMPUTE_PER_ROW*C + compute_fixed + compute_per_ctx*ctx); io = IO_BASE + IO_PER_ROW*C + io_fixed; x1.2(b) = b + b/5 (integer); fixed(L) = dense + L*n_experts*slot + kv + compute + io + max(4 GiB, ws/20) + pool; budget = min(physical - others - reserve, ws); refuse if fixed(1) > budget; L = 2 if fixed(2) + cache1 <= budget or budget - fixed(2) >= 17 GiB; cache = floor((budget - fixed(L))/slot)*slot
c_rule: walk ctx from max_context halving down to min_context; at a ctx take the largest C in {8192, 4096, 2048} admitted with cache >= SECOND_STAGING_MIN_CACHE, else 2048 if admitted, else halve ctx; none at min_context = load fails
